status_definitions.captured_provider_error: The replay itself displays a historical provider error instead of intended site content.

status_definitions.player_error_no_media_recovered: Video ID and metadata observed but replay player displayed an error; video bytes/playback unverified.
status_definitions.tool_timeout: Tool request timed out; destination content unverified.
